title: Why don't I qualify for Platinum Account benefits?
summary: This document explains why you may not qualify for Platinum Account benefits: your end-of-day balance is below $50,000, recent transactions or pending debits temporarily drop it below $50,000, or a scheduled transfer hasn’t fully settled. It instructs you to add funds, review recent/pending activity, and set balance alerts; benefits resume once your balance is restored to and remains at $50,000 (contact support in-app if you still think you qualify).
faqs: What are the common reasons I don’t qualify for Platinum Account benefits?
